title: Eventual vanishing of one raw cartesian derived class
statement: Let k be a field, I a small cofiltered category, D:I→Over(Spec k) a diagram with qcqs structure maps and affine transitions, and c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose apex structure morphism is qcqs. Let f:X→Spec k be qcqs, F an abelian etale sheaf on X, q a nonnegative integer, i an index, and V affine etale over c.pt. Put P=F[0] and L_i=cartesianDerivedImage(f,D_i.hom,P). If z:Z[V][0]→(c.π_i)^*L_i[q] becomes zero under the canonical cartesian exchange to cartesianDerivedImage(f,c.pt.hom,P)[q], then there exist j and a:j→i such that z becomes zero under the raw transition to (c.π_j)^*cartesianDerivedImage(f,D_j.hom,P)[q]. The transition is the canonical inverse-image composition comparison followed by pullback of cartesianDerivedImageMap along D(a). Definitions are [def-sc-cartesian-derived-image], [def-sc-cartesian-derived-image-map], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

proof.text: Use the chart-representative theorem to descend the arbitrary raw class and obtain the two identities with the constructed chart cohomology maps. This is the first continuity application with the original stage complex fixed.

The chart system is cofiltered and limiting with affine arrows and qcqs stage and apex maps. The apex chart isomorphism reflects zero, so the assumed vanishing kills the chart representative at the limit.

Construct the restricted-over abelian cohomology presentation and apply its complex-cohomology colimit theorem. Forget to sets, transport the zero equality by the presentation isomorphisms, and apply the filtered-colimit equality criterion to obtain an arrow on which the representative becomes zero.

Use the representative transition identity for that arrow and preservation of zero by all factors of the specified chart lift. The composite of its underlying arrow with the original stage arrow is the requested witness.

theorem exists_cartesianHigherImage_single_raw_class_eq_zero
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (i : I) (V : c.pt.left.Etale) [IsAffine V.left]
    (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((abelianComparisonFree c.pt.left).obj V) ⟶
        ((D+(((c.π.app i).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj
          (cartesianDerivedImage f (D.obj i).hom
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))⟦(q : ℤ)⟧)
    (hz : z ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
      (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj i).hom c.pt.hom (c.π.app i).left
        (Over.w (c.π.app i)).symm ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : j ⟶ i),
      z ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (c.π.app j).left (D.map a).left (c.π.app i).left
          (congrArg (fun b ↦ b.left) (c.w a)).symm).hom.app _ ≫
          (D+(((c.π.app j).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).map
            (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj i).hom (D.obj j).hom
              (D.map a).left (Over.w (D.map a)).symm
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))) = 0
